current_concerns.primary_problems: It’s mostly my mood and relationships, and it gets really tied to my period — I get irritable and my mood swings a lot beforehand, and then it’s like it settles down again once my period starts. At the moment I’m actually pretty okay, but the premenstrual bit is what’s been causing the problems.
current_concerns.goals: I want to get the mood swings under control, honestly. And… I guess I want to stop it from hurting my relationships so much.
